claim_ledger.claim: CHEEK19 adds visible occupied area below the optic but does not add source-specific construction density.
claim_ledger.observation: A continuous rounded dark sweep spans rear pivot to bill root; the broad fan-shaped gold sheet below it is an uninterrupted bright mass. Clay confirms the broad smooth shape rather than an effect caused only by metal shading. Source cheek uses irregular narrow plate courses, fasteners, smaller exposed mechanisms and deep layered recesses.
claim_ledger.consequence: Counting coverage as likeness gain would preserve a generic construction correction.
claim_ledger.next_test: No additional iteration requested by this QC; keep frozen BILL18 for final09.

claim_ledger.claim: There is no convincing whole-bird source likeness gain from CHEEK19.
claim_ledger.observation: Whole render is nearly the same outside the cheek. The new bright gold wedge becomes a distinct accent under the optic and broadens the rounded facial band; it does not reproduce the source fine dark cheek machinery. Existing large smooth cranial/bill forms and lower mechanical density remain.
claim_ledger.consequence: A local fill could be promoted despite failing the complete-image criterion.
claim_ledger.next_test: Review retained baseline in final09 without treating this rejected trial as full09 acceptance.

claim_ledger.claim: Anterior bill opening and lower-jaw hook remain readable, but the rear cheek opening is substantially occluded.
claim_ledger.observation: Front gap between upper hook and mandible remains dark and open. New insert replaces much of the rear negative space. Filling that region with a smooth bright panel weakens the source layered dark mouth/cheek reading rather than adding mechanical articulation.
claim_ledger.consequence: A technically open front mouth could conceal a visual cheek/mouth regression.

claim_ledger.claim: No new optic occlusion or obvious circular optic distortion is visible in supplied profile, grazing, or whole views.
claim_ledger.observation: Orange concentric face remains fully visible within its circular seat; the new cheek band sits beneath it. Existing flat disc reading relative to source optic depth is not resolved by this trial.
claim_ledger.consequence: Retaining optic visibility does not establish source realism or browser parity.
claim_ledger.next_test: Far profile, frontal views, era/browser exports and motion not reviewed in this narrow trial.

limits: Static PBR/clay visual review; no new renders, native edits, scripts, commits, integration, build, WebGL, export, motion, or deployment checks.
Candidate supplies only whole-source, near profile and grazing views in one era; no claim for all angles, all three eras, hidden rear topology or browser parity.
Source and model lighting differ; before/after camera metadata match, but visual construction judgment is qualitative, not measured geometric ground truth.
